question.text: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) exercises supervision over three professional bodies under separate Acts of Parliament. Which Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) is named in the workbook as the SRO for Social Impact Assessors?

answer.text: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI), acting directly as the SRO for SIAs
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), acting directly as the SRO for SIAs
Institute of Social Auditors of India - a Section 8 company under the aegis of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) acts as the SRO via its Financial Inclusion wing

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.59 names the SRO as the Institute of Social Auditors of India, a Section 8 company set up under the aegis of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Workbook p.37 also references the ICMAI Social Auditors Organization (ICMAI SAO) and the ICSI Institute of Social Auditors (ICSI ISA), but the SRO identified in the workbook for SIAs is the Institute of Social Auditors of India under the aegis of ICAI. The Trap: Option A places ICMAI directly as the SRO; the workbook frames ICMAI SAO as a parallel body but not as the SRO referenced here. Option B does the same with ICSI ISA. Option D incorrectly assigns the SRO role to RBI. Note: The acronym SRO here stands for Self-Regulatory Organization, and the source-backed SRO name on p.59 is the Institute of Social Auditors of India under the aegis of ICAI.
